1.text: May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.<sup foot_note="228299">1</sup>

footnotes.228299: - Abū Lahab (the Prophet's uncle) , who was an enemy of Islām.

2.text: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.

3.text: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame

4.text: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.<sup foot_note="228300">1</sup>

footnotes.228300: - She used to put thorns in the Prophet's path and slander him (ﷺ) . The word "firewood" was used by the Arabs to allude to slander and backbiting.

5.text: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
